item.title: Savannah Guthrie pleads for mother’s return, says family will pay
item.description: Savannah Guthrie, co-host of the "Today" show, released a video message on Saturday, telling the apparent kidnappers of her mother, Nancy, that she has received their message.

item.title: 'Her name will always live': Cleveland celebrates Tanisha's Law
item.description: Cleveland City Council passed Tanisha's Law during a meeting Monday. To celebrate, the Social Justice Law Center and Social Justice Institute at CWRU had an event honoring Tanisha Anderson's legacy.

item.title: Local restaurant holds watch party for USA women's hockey to cheer on Laila Edwards
item.description: As day 1 of the Winter Olympics in Italy began Saturday, from 4,300 miles away, people in Cleveland Heights spent the morning supporting their own: Laila Edwards.
